Overview

Are you ready to challenge your thinking, solve problems, and showcase your creativity?

Join IDEATHON 6.0: Ideas into Impact, an exciting individual-level quiz competition designed to test your aptitude, logical reasoning, analytical skills, and ability to build innovative ideas. Challenge yourself, think beyond conventional boundaries, and demonstrate how creative thinking can lead to practical solutions.

Prize Money: ₹5,000

Register now and put your knowledge, intelligence, and creativity to the test!

Eligibility Criteria

  • The competition is open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from recognized colleges and universities.
  • Participation is strictly on an individual basis.
  • Each participant must register individually using accurate details.

Competition Structure

Round 1 – BRAINWAVE: Aptitude & Idea Building Quiz

The competition consists of a single round combining aptitude questions and creative idea-building tasks.

Part A: Aptitude Challenge

  • Participants will answer 20 questions in 20 minutes.
  • Questions will cover quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, analytical thinking, critical thinking, and problem-solving.
  • Participants must complete the quiz within the allotted time.

Part B: Idea Building Challenge

  • Participants will be presented with one real-world problem statement.
  • Each participant must independently propose an original and innovative solution.
  • The submission should briefly describe the problem, proposed solution, uniqueness, feasibility, and expected impact.
  • Participants must submit their ideas within the time limit specified by the organizers.

Evaluation Criteria

Participants will be evaluated based on:

  • Aptitude and logical reasoning
  • Creativity and originality
  • Problem-solving ability
  • Relevance to the given problem statement
  • Feasibility and potential impact of the proposed idea

The final results will be determined by the organizers and judges based on the announced evaluation criteria.

Rules and Regulations

  • Participation is individual; team entries are not permitted.
  • Participants must complete the quiz and idea submission within the allotted time.
  • Mobile phones, external assistance, and unauthorized resources are prohibited during the quiz.
  • All idea submissions must be original. Plagiarism or copying another participant's work may result in disqualification.

Prize

Winner: ₹5,000 cash prize

Test your aptitude, unleash your creativity, and prove that one brilliant mind can make a difference!

IDEATHON 6.0 – Ideas into Impact: Think Smart. Innovate Boldly. Make an Impact.
